name: get_change_item
description: One change item with everything upstream says about it: the upstream change (title, detail text, subjects, references) or compatibility change, the upstream evidence records (URI, locator, verbatim excerpt), the upstream source artifacts (read them with read_artifact), migration notes, the release- and environment-scope rendered changes correlated to it, and the deterministic join's findings for it. Start every item here: for a controller-behaviour item the upstream text is where the setting that restores the old behaviour is named.

name: list_renders
description: Every render pair of the investigation: scope (environment = rendered with this environment's own configuration; release = chart defaults), target, status (only ok is a complete render; partial/unavailable are evidence gaps, never 'no change'), reason, number of rendered changes by class, and how many are uncorrelated (no change item explains them).

name: query_diff
description: Filter the rendered changes (the semantic before/after diff of the renders). Every set field must match; list fields match any element. Results come in a fixed order, at most `limit` per page; pass the returned `next` as `after` to continue. Unknown targets, change items, classes or cursors are rejected rather than answered with an empty page.

target.description: render target as list_renders names it

changeItem.description: only changes correlated to this change item

uncorrelated.description: only changes no change item explains

classes.description: render change classes, e.g. field-changed, container-arg-added, image-changed, rbac-permission-removed

pathPrefix.description: field path prefix inside the object

after.description: continuation cursor: the `next` of the previous page

name: get_rendered_object
description: One rendered object, or one field of it, from the from or the to render of a render pair, as YAML (secret values redacted). found=false means the object or field is absent on that side (a fact, not an error). The result names the render artifact: cite it with {artifact, locator: <object and path>, quote: <text from the YAML>}.

path.description: field path inside the object, e.g. spec.template.spec.containers[name=controller].args; empty = the whole object

name: search_manifest
description: Search the investigation's artifact manifest (upstream documents, environment files, renders, diffs, environment facts). `terms` must each match a tag, the path or the kind of an artifact; `grep`, an RE2 pattern, returns matching lines (bounded). Artifacts with secrets are searched in redacted form.

changeItem.description: only artifacts related to this change item

grep.description: RE2 pattern matched line by line

name: read_artifact
description: Read a window of an artifact's text: lines fromLine..toLine (1-based, inclusive; at most 400 lines / 64 KiB per call), or the node at yamlPath (dot path with [n] indices; a leading [n] selects the n-th YAML document, 0-based). Every byte returned counts against your read budget: read windows, not whole files.

name: expand_graph
description: The neighbourhood of a node of the relationship graph (secondary context: consumers a render cannot show). Edges point in the direction impact propagates: from the provider to the consumer. Status established = from evidence; inferred/missing = unresolved.

name: list_paths
description: Impact paths of the bounded traversal from each change item's exposure roots (the objects of its correlated environment rendered changes, then the join's matches).

unresolved.description: only paths with an inferred or missing edge

name: request_evidence
description: Ask for evidence the investigation does not have: an upstream artifact (a linked PR, a file at a tag), a change source whose status is not ok, an environment input that was not supplied. The request is recorded for the next collection round; nothing is fetched during this session. Live-cluster reads are disabled.

target.description: URL, change source kind, environment path or GVK

name: request_validation
description: Ask a deterministic validator to test a change item against environment subjects now. Kinds: override-inspection (does an explicit environment setting pin the old behaviour?), render-diff (does the item's effect reach these rendered objects?), schema-compat, static-reference, runtime. The validator, not you, produces the result (pass / fail / error / not-run); a validator that cannot decide never passes.

subjects.description: graph node ids or keys the property is checked for

paths.description: impact path ids of this change item

inputs.description: artifact ids you suggest the validator reads

name: record_hypothesis
description: Record a testable statement about a change item, with at least one citation. Every citation is checked: the artifact must exist and the quote must occur verbatim in its bytes (whitespace-insensitive).

name: record_assertion
description: Record a claim about a change item with at least one checked citation. raises-concern = a plausible impact (blocks a not-affected conclusion until a passing validation answers it); explains = reasoning attached to the finding; claims-mitigation = you believe something mitigates the change (it stays an unvalidated assumption until a validation establishes it). A proposedEdge adds an inferred relationship (never established).

from.description: provider: node id, node key, or <node kind>:<key> for a node not in the graph

name: submit_findings
description: End the session with a closing summary per change item you investigated (each recorded as an explains assertion, with at least one checked citation). It never sets a class: the deterministic policy classifies. After submitting, stop.
